apps.name: Photo Drop
apps.desc: Guests scan a code and drop photos onto a shared desk. You approve each one first.
apps.about: Run a live photo wall at a party: guests scan a QR code and send photos from their phones, you approve each one, and they land on a big screen like prints thrown on a desk.

apps.name: Photo Stitch
apps.desc: Join photos vertically, side by side or in a grid.
apps.about: Put several photos into one image: stacked, side by side or in a grid, with borders, gaps and an exact output size. Everything happens in your browser.

apps.name: Video Tools
apps.desc: Owns the video tools proxy (the three video gadgets open pages on it).

apps.name: Panel Transcript
apps.desc: Turn a clip into a strip of subtitled stills.
apps.about: Upload a clip with people talking: it picks a still for each line, writes down what’s said and stacks the stills into one image with the lines as subtitles. You name the speakers before it’s made.

apps.name: Join Clips
apps.desc: Join clips end to end, with fades if you like.
apps.about: Put several clips together into one video. Clips that match are joined in seconds without losing quality; add fades or crossfades, or mix phones and cameras, and it converts them to one format first.

apps.name: Cut a Clip
apps.desc: Cut a stretch out of a longer video.
apps.about: Pick a start and an end and get just that part: an exact MP4 that plays on any phone (HDR colours fixed), or a fast copy in the original quality.

apps.name: Quote Finder
apps.desc: Search the dialogue of everything in Plex: find the episode from a quote.
apps.about: Remember a line but not the episode? Type what you remember and find the show, episode and moment it’s said, across everything in Plex. Then turn the scene into panels or a clip.
